name: Bénin
status: issued 20 October 2026: 4,147,741 codes, one for every compound; registry public
designCriteria: 0. Official addresses first: where the State gives a door or street address (Cotonou 2013 plan; the 2026 national programme once delivered) it is shown first, exactly as written; every compound also has its N-Ways code beside it

1. Easy to remember and easy to get: a short plate name (at most 12 characters and 2 words) taken from the place name people already use + a 4-digit number read in two pairs (5 digits for the 134 names whose areas need more than 9,000 numbers); unique in all of Benin on its own, with no commune or app position; nothing to learn by heart beyond that
2. The compound (concession) is the unit; the gate is the primary entrance
3. Every structure carries a building profile with source and confirmation date per attribute
4. Works offline; open method and data
5. Stable: a code never moves or changes; renames only change aliases
6. Beside official systems: points to Cotonou street codes, ANDF parcels and the 2026 national strategy; never called a postcode or official
7. Privacy: codes describe places, never people

existingSystems.verdict: no postal codes; door-level street addresses only in parts of Cotonou (2013 plan); national strategy authorised 22 Apr 2026, format unpublished

remembered.pattern: <plate name> · <NN NN> (or <NN NNN> for a five-digit name)
rules: the name is the area's plate name: at most 12 characters and 2 words (nationalNames.plateNames)
number 4 digits (1000-9999), read as two pairs; 5 digits (10000-99999) for names whose national range needs it, read like a French postcode ('15 170' = 'quinze cent soixante-dix')
unique nationally on its own: the name's national range and frozen blocks give one area; no commune, no app position needed
a commune after a comma is accepted only if it is the right one; it never chooses between areas

written.plateSmallPrint: official area name when it differs from the plate name (Camp Peulh Soukoumpérou), commune and arrondissement in small type (Cotonou · 9e arr.), as a help to the eye only

machine.checkDigitsOver: national name index (5 digits) + number (5 digits, zero-padded); the area digits are verified against the frozen block table

forms.plateRule: where an official door number of the 2013 plan exists, the gate keeps that number; N-Ways adds only a QR sticker on request

levels.why: too large (Atacora, Alibori, Borgou, Collines need 8-char spot codes; 0.3-0.94 M structures each) and not what people say

levels.numbering: official ordinal where the name has one (Cotonou 1-13, Porto-Novo 1-5, Parakou 1-3, Natitingou 1-4, Djougou 1-3, Bohicon 1-2...), else alphabetical rank after the ordinals; frozen at first issue
levels.why: Cotonou street codes start with the arrondissement number (Rue 12.217); spot frames

levels.law: Loi 2013-05 du 27 mai 2013 (annex: 5290 villages et quartiers de ville; Cotonou 165)
levels.index: alphabetical rank of the named OSM places of the arrondissement (model/keys.json, 12,932 places), frozen at first issue; the Loi 2013-05 annex maps onto it through aliases

codeAreas.definition: a quartier or village of an arrondissement, named after it; a point belongs to the area whose frozen place point is nearest in its arrondissement
construction: the named OSM places of each arrondissement, frozen at first issue with their place points and numbering frames
an arrondissement with no named place has one area, index 000, named after it

an area of more than 4,250 compounds takes five digits and keeps one block (118 areas: Ladji Farani, Lokossa, Cococodji, Tanguiéta, Malanville...); its official quartiers become aliases when published

evidence.cotonouDesign: model/stats/capital-areas.json: 75 areas, compounds p50 1,067, p90 3,377, max 4,124 (Zogbo)
evidence.nationalDesign: model/stats/national-areas.json: 12,892 areas, p50 114, p90 707, p99 3,691, max 19,349; 84.4% of compounds in areas fitting 3-4 digits
evidence.issued: model/stats/building-stats.json: 4,147,741 compounds in 12,845 areas (119 areas have none)

codeAreas.aliases: spoken-name alias table; renames/re-districting change aliases only

nationalNames.rule: the remembered code is unique nationally on its own: one area in four shares its name, and a code is said and written far from where it was issued, so context (commune, app position) cannot be relied on

steps: Gbe letters ɔ ɛ ɖ ŋ ƒ ʋ ɣ -> o e d ng f v g; œ -> oe
split on non-alphanumerics (spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, dots)
drop a leading French article le/la/les/l'
trailing Roman numeral or ordinal -> digit (Ganvié I = Ganvié 1 = Ganvié 1er)
plate abbreviations St/Ste read as Saint/Sainte
fold spellings: tch->c, dj->j, ph->f, ou before a vowel->w, doubled letters->one
normalisation.appliesTo: the plate name of each area; the official name is an alias when it maps to one plate name

plateNames.rule: the remembered name is at most 12 characters and 2 words: it is said on the phone and painted on a gate

limit.words: parts between spaces or hyphens; linking words (de, du, des, la, le, les, l', d', et, sur, es) do not count
limit.counting: every character of the NFC form counts one: letters (an accented letter is one), spaces, hyphens, apostrophes
limit.digits: allowed: an ordinal that is part of the name (Ganvié 1, Adja 2); the written form keeps it apart from the number with '·'

plateNames.twoNames: officialName = full name of the area (small print, never required); plateName = the name in the code
derivation: documented short form (known table, with source) (none recorded yet)

clean: close a one-sided spaced hyphen ("Lèlè- Honmèho" -> "Lèlè-Honmèho"), drop quotation marks; drop text in brackets, after a slash, mapping placeholders; drop French generic words (Quartier, Cité, Lotissement, Zone, Secteur, Village, Village de, Hameau, Campement, Site des logements sociaux); "Camp Peulh X" -> "Peulh X"
Saint/Sainte -> St/Ste when that makes it fit (the key expands them back)
else the most distinctive run of whole words (rarest words nationally, preference for the end of the name), taken only when clearly ahead and not a town in the avoid list
else needsCouncilChoice with up to 3 candidates; the first is used provisionally and the area is issued under it; the commune may choose once, and its choice becomes an alias
a word is never cut; a name a person carries (Aladji X, Orou X, Bio X, Sabi X) is never split
a hyphenated name with no fitting run: its parts are candidates, never an automatic choice
plateNames.weakWords: never a plate name alone; after the name they are qualifiers only the commune may drop: Peulh, Bariba, Gando, Dendi, Haoussa, Gah, Gouré, Gnel, Kparou, Camp, Centre, Gare, Plage, Barrage, Carrefour, Marché, Nord, Sud, Est, Ouest, an ordinal
plateNames.avoid: a plate never equals another town: the 77 commune seats (with Calavi, Dassa, Missérété, Sèmè, Bossito), the 12 department names, the big towns and names of the four neighbouring countries; the area's own commune is allowed
plateNames.aliases: normalised official name -> plate name in model/names.json when it maps to one plate name and is not another area's plate name; otherwise listed in aliasesDropped
plateNames.engine: bj_engine.plate_ok / remembered refuse a name over the limit unless it is the provisional name of a flagged area; every flagged area is issued under its provisional name
plateNames.fields: model/keys.json places: plate (when it differs), plateRule (as-is, cleaned, abbreviated, known, distinctive, council), needsCouncilChoice, plateCandidates (<= 3), plateReason

examples.official: Poste forestier des Chutes de Koudou

nationalNames.block: one per area: max(200, ceil(2 x compounds / 100) x 100), at most 85,000; laid end to end from the bottom of the range in area-key order (commune, arrondissement, quartier index)

spare.use: future areas with the same name and extension blocks for full areas

nationalNames.digitsRule: 4 if blocks + 500 <= 9,000; else 5 if blocks + 5,000 <= 90,000; else qualifier
nationalNames.decode: normalise name -> range -> block containing the number -> one area; numbers in spare space are not issued
frozen: block table frozen at first issue
blocks never moved, resized or renumbered
a name's digit count never changes
new area with an existing name -> next block from the name's spare space
full area -> extension block from the spare space
spare exhausted -> the new area takes the name's listed qualifier

qualifiers.rule: one established qualifier people already say, decided once per name and listed here
qualifiers.note: none needed: the largest range of any name (Ladji Farani) holds 46,100 of its 90,000 numbers

counts2026.basis: issued register; on official names: 11,208 names, 1,024 shared by 2,780 areas

numbering.nationalRange: per normalised name: 1000-9999 (4 digits) or 10000-99999 (5 digits); see nationalNames
numbering.digits: 4, or 5 for names whose blocks + 500 exceed 9,000
numbering.capacityRule: block = max(200, ceil(2 x compounds / 100) x 100), at most 85,000
numbering.order: Hilbert curve (order 16) over the code area's frozen frame, over compound reference points (structures are grouped first)
numbering.mainBlock: first two thirds of the area's block
numbering.step: s = max(1, floor(floor(2B/3) / N)) for a block of size B
numbering.tailReserve: top third of the area's block
numbering.newCompound: free number between the Hilbert neighbours' numbers, closest to their midpoint; else the lowest free number in the block's tail reserve; a full block gets an extension block from the name's spare space
numbering.split: the part with the gate keeps the code; the rest gets a new number
numbering.merged: oldest code survives; the other becomes an alias

detects: in the number, including one that would land in another area with the same name (tested exhaustively on real blocks)
checkDigit.binds: name + number + area: name and number fix the area through the frozen block table; machine-form area digits are checked against that table
checkDigit.whyAreaNotInSum: a typo in the number can also change its area; with two inputs changed Damm would lose its guarantee

spotGrid.why: all of Benin (0.77-3.85°E) is in zone 31N; ANDF cadastre uses EPSG:32631; survey beacons import without reprojection
spotGrid.frame: per arrondissement: origin = SW corner of its outline rounded down to 1 km; 3 chars per axis (24 km) or 4 (480 km)
spotGrid.interleave: northing and easting characters alternate from the most significant

types: case et concession rurale sans mur

order: mapped enclosure (OSM wall/fence/hedge closed, 30-6000 m²) -> confidence 0.85
annex attach: structure < 30 m² joins nearest structure >= 30 m² within 6 m -> 0.6
hut cluster (rural Borgou, Alibori, Atacora, Collines only): huts < 40 m² within 3 m chain, max 25 -> 0.5
people: 'ces bâtiments sont une seule maison', 'voici le portail'; consensus settles, nothing queued for review

fields.class: residential-one-household | residential-multi-household | residential-multi-storey | mixed | commercial | institutional | industrial | unclassified
fields.parcelRefs: ANDF NUP / îlot+parcelle / TF when the landholder gives them (private unless the landholder publishes them)

fields.classSource: osm:building | osm:poi | nways-places | osm:landuse | size | default | door-confirmation | partner | add-my-home
fields.heightM: OSM height only (the Google/Microsoft height is a rendering filler and is not used)
fields.floors: OSM building:levels, else round(OSM height / 3) (at least 1), else 1

entrances.lakeVillages: Sô-Ava stilt houses: entrance 1 is the landing (ponton) reached by pirogue

steps: at the gate: GPS averaged a few seconds + one gate photo -> entrance 1

outline: tap corners on imagery | walk inside the wall with AR world tracking (ARKit/ARCore), anchored by GPS averaged over the walk, checked vs imagery and footprints | import the plan parcellaire (beacons typed or photographed; UTM 31N)
provisional code at once: next reserved number in the quartier (between Hilbert neighbours, else tail reserve)
confirmed by deliveries/arrivals at the gate, no neighbour dispute, or new imagery/footprints
safeguards: an N-Ways code is an address, not a land title (shown in the flow)
overlaps with compounds or ANDF parcels flagged, not issued
gate on the outline; plausible size 20-20,000 m²; closed loop; GPS vs AR within 5 m
offline: spot code at once; compound code on next connection
